title: Original WAM channel manager singleton and independent map state
oracle: Actual original singleton methods operate on two realm-native Maps. Literal initial/close/resume state, per-key/per-map isolation, Map SameValueZero primitive key behavior, bounded truthy/falsy value forwarding and retained real manager-key identity are asserted. An independent ordered-record host model supplies expected states after generated close/reinitialize/busy histories; only JSON plans/expected data enter worker. closeChannelManager and direct close reset map values without replacing the singleton.

trials.configurationScope: one empty supported static gate assignment across this single-module helper closure
trials.primitiveKeyScope: Selected number/string/boolean/null/undefined/NaN/unicode/control-character keys; NaN equivalence; signed zero is not represented by the existing JSON number transport
trials.busyValueScope: Selected truthy/falsy values characterize loose stored-value-or-false semantics, not boolean validation

exclusions: WAM channel-manager state only; no actual channel/sink/provider/queue/storage/transport/commit/flush/network/account initialization or acceptance.
Close is in-instance map-value reset and retains the singleton. No worker/process restart, teardown/disposal, map-entry deletion or memory cleanup is inferred.
Manager object used as a real retained Map key; no host object/function/callback is injected and no fake channel or sink is supplied.
Finite gate completeness is scoped to the single no-dependency module. Arbitrary channel keys, values and histories remain unbounded; generated cases are characterization only.
Truthiness forwarding is source behavior, not a typed boolean-only contract or validation guarantee.
Container execution, production TypeScript suite scheduling, named-library parity, original browser bootstrap and security proof remain unexercised.
